meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能分析任何文字，提取作者的思维指纹：包括12个认知维度的评分、张力图、推理拓扑和决策特征。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某人如何思考、理解认知风格，或说出“thinking pattern”“cognitive profile”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 分析这段话的思维模式
say.note: Claude 会输出认知维度评分和推理拓扑。

say.text: 比较这两篇文章的认知特征
say.note: Claude 会生成单独画像并对比异同。

say.text: 看看我的思维风格是什么
say.note: Claude 基于当前对话分析你的认知指纹。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze any text to extract the author's cognitive fingerprint, scoring 12 cognitive dimensions, generating tension maps, reasoning topology, and decision fingerprint.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, or mention keywords like "thinking pattern", "cognitive profile", etc.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking pattern of this text.
say_en.note: Claude will output cognitive dimension scores and reasoning topology.

say_en.text: Compare the cognitive signatures of these two articles.
say_en.note: Claude generates individual profiles and a comparison synthesis.
Claude analyzes your cognitive fingerprint based on the conversation.
